title: Applicationcomponent realizes Applicationservice
description: The component's internal behaviour is what concretely delivers the operations that the service promises to its consumers. This is a shortcut through the functions and processes assigned to the component, for when those are not modelled separately; links from the service to other layers go from the service, not the component.
x-dr-evidence: The component's class implements the service's interface or contract, such as an OpenAPI or protobuf service definition, with method bodies backing each operation.
